predictedBugs: The server-only package can throw when the CLI runs through tsx without the react-server condition.
A naive operation regex can classify unrelated get/put calls as Vercel Blob operations.
The POC could report success after checksum verification even if cleanup of its object failed.
Hash.digest() cannot be called and then copied/reused to produce the same checksum.
edgeCases: The final multipart chunk can be smaller than 5 MiB while configured chunks remain between 5 and 95 MiB.
The NAS can fail before multipart starts or during a later part; only the former may select fallback.
A declared size can differ from the bytes yielded by a file or deterministic stream.
An evidence destination may already exist and must never be overwritten silently.
A completed object with a checksum mismatch still requires deletion of only its generated key.
